note: Every external data source used for medication flags: where it came from, which release, when it was retrieved, and its licence. Files are downloaded by a person with the scripts named here; the application never calls these sources.

ddinter.name: DDInter 2.0 drug-drug interaction database
ddinter.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike), as stated on the DDInter terms page
ddinter.attribution: DDInter, Computational Biology & Drug Design Group (Xiangya School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Central South University).
ddinter.disclaimer: DDInter states it cannot guarantee accuracy or completeness and that the absence of an interaction does not mean no interaction exists.
ddinter.fields: Drug A, Drug B, severity level (Major, Moderate, Minor, Unknown). The download files carry no mechanism or management text.
ddinter.gaps: The download offers ATC groups A, B, D, H, L, P, R and V only; pairs where neither drug is in one of these groups may be missing.
ddinter.use: Final year project, non-commercial. A real deployment needs a licensed source or written permission.

openfda_labels.name: openFDA drug labeling (US FDA structured product labels)
openfda_labels.licence: openFDA data is public domain (CC0), per open.fda.gov terms; labels are US labelling and may not match Pakistani products.

rxnav.name: US NLM RxNav (RxNorm codes; RxClass for WHO ATC codes)
rxnav.licence: RxNorm is free; some source vocabularies have their own terms (see NLM RxNorm terms of service).

brand_names.name: Pakistani brand names (curated)
brand_names.licence: Written for this project from general knowledge; not from DRAP or DrugsInfo Pakistan (neither offers a bulk file; permission not obtained).
brand_names.status: Not yet confirmed by a pharmacist.
